attacks.text: Look through your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards and attach them to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like. Shuffle your deck.

cards.text: The Pokémon holding this can use the attack on this card (it still needs the Energy). If this card is attached to 1 of your Pokémon, discard it at the end of your turn.

cards.name: Tulip
cards.text: Put up to 4 in any combination of Psychic Pokémon and Basic Psychic Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand.

cards.name: Medical Energy
cards.text: Provides Colorless Energy. When you attach this card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon, heal 30 damage from that Pokémon.

cards.name: Beach Court
cards.text: The Retreat Cost of each Basic Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) is 1 Colorless Energy less.

cards.name: Reversal Energy
cards.text: Provides Colorless Energy. If you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent, and if this card is attached to an Evolution Pokémon that doesn't have a Rule Box (Pokémon ex, Pokémon V and the like have Rule Boxes), this card provides every type of Energy but provides only 3 Energy at a time.
